title: Zetta-Joule scroll reveal
description: A wrapper that fades its content in while it scrolls into view. 'rise' lifts 16px; 'lines' lifts 30px and uncovers a block of text from top to bottom with a soft edge. Scrubbed by the scroll, not timed.
notes: CSS scroll-driven animation: browsers without it show the content in place
do not put it inside a horizontally scrolling box: its timeline would follow that box
name: zetta-joule-reveal

props.name: variant
props.description: rise: fade in and lift 16px (buttons, cards); lines: a text block that lifts 30px and uncovers top to bottom

props.name: distance
props.description: how far it lifts, in px (default 16 for rise, 30 for lines)
